hero.subtitle: A gentle guide to 4-7-8 breathing, with calming visuals, haptic cues, and optional Apple Health insights.
hero.platforms: Available on iPhone and Apple Watch.

technique.label: The Technique
technique.title2: A simple rhythm for mindful breathing.
technique.description: Popularized by Dr. Andrew Weil, the 4-7-8 pattern is commonly used as a relaxation practice. Start gently, never strain, and use a pace that feels comfortable.
technique.inhaleDesc: Breathe in quietly through your nose

iphone.label: iPhone
iphone.feature1Desc: A living, breathing flower animation guides your rhythm with fluid motion and color transitions.
iphone.feature2Desc: Subtle vibrations mark each phase so you can close your eyes and simply feel the rhythm.
iphone.feature3Desc: Track every session. View trends. Build a daily practice with streaks and insights.

watch.label: Apple Watch
watch.description: A fully independent watchOS app. Start a session right from your wrist with beautiful animations and precise haptic feedback.

health.label: Health
health.card1Desc: View HRV values available from Apple Health alongside your session history. HRV varies for many reasons and does not measure the effect of a single session.
health.card2Desc: Review heart rate samples available from Apple Health around your practice. These values are for general wellness context, not medical interpretation.
health.card3Desc: Every session automatically saves to Apple Health as mindful minutes. Your practice counts toward your daily goals.

benefits.title: Why 4-7-8?
benefits.b1Desc: A structured breathing rhythm may help some people settle and unwind.
benefits.b2Desc: Use it as an optional wind-down routine before bed.
benefits.b3Desc: Pause and reconnect with your breathing during a busy day.
benefits.b4Desc: Bring your attention back to the present for a few moments.
benefits.b5Desc: Streaks, history, and insights keep you motivated.
benefits.b6Desc: All data stays on your device. No accounts. No tracking.

safety.label: Practice Safely
safety.title: Comfort comes before the count.
safety.description: 4-7-8 Breathe is a general wellness and relaxation tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition.
items: Start with a short session and never force or strain a breath hold.
Stop and return to normal breathing if you feel dizzy, short of breath, faint, or uncomfortable.
Do not practice while driving, in water, or during any activity where dizziness could be dangerous.
Ask a healthcare professional before use if you have a respiratory or cardiovascular condition, are pregnant, or have other health concerns.

privacy.sectionDesc: The native app keeps session history on your devices and does not send HealthKit data to our servers. No account, advertising, or in-app tracking is required.

cta.subtitle: Free to download. Available on iPhone and Apple Watch.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.overviewText: 4-7-8 Breathe ("the App") is designed to keep your breathing history and health information under your control. The developer does not receive your App session history, HealthKit data, or health measurements.
privacyPage.dataCollectionText: The native App does not send personal or health information to the developer. Specifically:
dataCollectionItems: No account creation or sign-in required
No crash reporting to external servers
No data shared with third parties
privacyPage.healthDataText: The App integrates with Apple HealthKit to read heart rate variability (HRV) and heart rate data, and to write mindful minutes. This data is:
healthDataItems: Accessed only with your explicit permission
May sync between your paired iPhone and Apple Watch using Apple's WatchConnectivity framework
Never transmitted to the developer or an advertising service
privacyPage.healthDataFooter: HealthKit permissions are controlled through Apple system settings. The App may also store selected session-linked values locally so they can appear in your history.
privacyPage.storageText: Your breathing session history and preferences are stored locally on your iPhone and Apple Watch using SwiftData and system preferences. They remain until you delete available history entries, reset or uninstall the App, or otherwise remove the data through device controls.
privacyPage.controlsText: You can revoke Health access at any time in Apple Settings under Privacy & Security > Health. You can delete individual history entries in the iPhone App. To remove remaining local App data, uninstall the App from the relevant device. Mindful minutes written to Apple Health can be reviewed or deleted in the Health app.
privacyPage.networkText: Core breathing sessions work offline. The native App does not upload your session or HealthKit data to a developer-operated server. Opening external support or privacy links requires a network connection.
privacyPage.websiteAnalyticsText: This website uses Vercel Web Analytics to understand aggregate site traffic and performance. Website analytics are separate from the native App and do not receive HealthKit data or App session history. Vercel processes website usage and device information under its own privacy terms.
privacyPage.childrenText: The App is not directed to children. The developer does not knowingly receive children's App session history or HealthKit data. A parent or guardian should supervise a minor's use of breathing exercises and Apple Health features.
privacyPage.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated revision date.
